name: Hallowed Wings
look: a white feathered Arceus with its golden wheel, a dark wavy mane, a hooked bird-like face under white crest feathers, great white feathered wings and gold-tipped hooves
entry: A Pokémon resembling Arceus, described in the oldest of myths as the first being to take wing over the newborn world. Its golden wheel shines like the sun at noon.
how: Wild: very rare at noon high on mountain peaks (above y 140).
